subject_line: Featuring the story behind We Can't Be Friends
email_body:
Hi Cyndy,

I came across We Can't Be Friends, your memoir about returning to Masuk High School after sixteen months at Straight, Inc., and noticed that you now coach teens through motivation and confidence at The Teen Life Coach. It is striking how your own story of survival connects so directly to the work you do with young people today.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short cinematic trailer or a few promotional reels for We Can't Be Friends is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, built around the voice and honesty readers connect with in your story. It is an entirely optional add-on, separate from the Spotlight, and only if it feels useful for the book.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit We Can't Be Friends: A True Story best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
